name: Chilly and Me
source:
Chilly and me is a Christian short story about a boy named Issac and his pet chinchilla Chilly. At first, they are really close, but later Chilly grows to resent Isaac. 

The boy will need to make a tough choice between his pet's well being. 

[From [url=https://fielstoria.itch.io/chilly-and-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《奇利和我》是一部基督教短篇小说，讲述了一个名叫伊萨克的男孩和他的宠物龙猫奇利的故事。起初，他们非常亲密，但后来奇利逐渐对艾萨克产生了怨恨。

男孩需要在宠物的健康与健康之间做出艰难的选择。

[来自[url=https://fielstoria.itch.io/chilly-and-me]Itch.io[/url]]
